templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA, letting each party disclose confidential information for an agreed purpose. Covers permitted use, protection obligations, exclusions, compelled disclosure, and term. Used together with the MNDA cover page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the Mutual NDA. Captures the parties, effective date, purpose, confidentiality period, governing law, and signature blocks, and incorporates the MNDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a SaaS/cloud subscription. Covers access and use rights, customer data, security, warranties, indemnities, limitation of liability, fees, and term and termination, referencing a cover page and order form.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for licensing installed or on-premise software. Covers the license grant and restrictions, delivery, support, intellectual property, warranties, indemnities, liability, and subscription term.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for professional or consulting services delivered under statements of work. Covers SOW mechanics, deliverables and their ownership, customer responsibilities, fees and expenses, warranties, and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data protection addendum setting out the controller, processor, and subprocessor relationships for customer personal data. Covers processing instructions, security measures, subprocessors, international transfers, audits, and data subject requests.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate addendum governing a provider's use and disclosure of protected health information. Covers permitted uses, safeguards, breach notification, subcontractors, and return or destruction of PHI.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support addendum for a cloud service. Defines target uptime and how it is measured, excluded downtime, support response targets, and service credits as the remedy for missed targets.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum covering AI features layered onto an existing product agreement. Addresses input and output ownership, permitted use of AI services, training restrictions, disclaimers about accuracy, and customer responsibilities.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a time-boxed paid or unpaid pilot or proof of concept. Covers pilot access and evaluation purpose, the pilot period, feedback, confidentiality, and what happens when the pilot converts or ends.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for an early-access design partnership. Covers early product access, the partner's feedback obligations, ownership of feedback and resulting improvements, confidentiality, publicity, and term.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a commercial partnership such as a referral, reseller, or co-marketing arrangement. Covers each party's obligations, feedback, trademark and publicity rights, confidentiality, and liability.
